Express Parcel Delivery
Fast, Reliable, and
Nationwide Express Parcel Delivery
Deliver your parcels swiftly and securely across India with XpressBees Express Parcel Delivery. From e-commerce shipments to urgent business consignments, our robust network ensures your packages reach customers on time, every time.
Ship Now
Why choose us
Extensive Reach
Seamless express delivery to 19,000+ pin codes across metros, Tier-2/3 cities, and remote locations.
Time-Definite Delivery
Guaranteed Same Day, Next Day, and 48-hour delivery options for critical shipments.
Technology-Enabled Tracking
Real-time parcel visibility and proactive notifications for you and your customers.
Flexible Pickup Solutions
Doorstep pickups, scheduled dispatches, and customizable workflows to fit your business model.
How it works
Step - 1
Order Creation & Pickup Request
Create your shipment online via our dashboard or API. Schedule a convenient pickup slot.
Step - 2
Parcel Pickup & Labeling
Our delivery partner collects the parcel from your location and scans it for tracking.
Step - 3
Sorting & Transit
The shipment moves through our automated sort centers and optimized line-haul network.
Step - 4
Last-Mile Delivery
A local delivery executive delivers the parcel to the customer’s doorstep with signature or OTP confirmation.
Step - 5
Delivery Confirmation
Real-time status updates and proof of delivery are shared instantly.

FAQ
What is Express Parcel Delivery?
Express Parcel Delivery is a fast shipping service that ensures your parcels are delivered within the shortest timeframes, such as Same Day or Next Day.
How soon can you pick up a parcel after booking?
We typically arrange pickups within 2–4 hours of request in major cities and by the next working day in other locations.
Which locations do you cover for express delivery?
We cover over 19,000 pin codes across India, including metros, Tier-2/3 cities, and remote areas.
Can I track my shipment in real-time?
Yes, every parcel has end-to-end tracking, and you receive live updates at each milestone.
Do you offer Same Day Delivery?
Yes, Same Day Delivery is available in select metro cities for eligible shipments.
How are parcels packed for secure transit?
Parcels are securely packed with tamper-proof materials and labelled with scannable barcodes to ensure safety.
What size or weight limitations apply to express parcels?
We handle parcels up to 30 kg for express delivery. For larger shipments, custom solutions are available.
Can I integrate XpressBees Express Delivery with my e-commerce website?
Absolutely—our APIs and plugins seamlessly integrate with most major platforms.
Do you handle Cash on Delivery (COD) with express services?
Yes, we support COD, prepaid, and card-on-delivery options.
How do I get started with XpressBees Express Parcel Delivery?
Simply contact our sales team or sign up on our website to create your business account and schedule your first shipment.
